findings.body_priority: death wins, then active skill391/392/393, then hurtTime hurt, horizontal motion walk, idle. Incoming ordinary hurt does not visually replace an active skill. No separate STUN clip branch. Gameplay stun may outlast hurt clip and display idle/walk.
findings.interrupt_exit: Accepted server damage while alive with actual health loss>=8 and WINDUP stuns20 and immediately syncs. ACTIVE/RECOVERY do not use this custom interrupt. Death cancels attack, clears owned effects, navigation/target, syncs deathStart and chooses death; getDeathMaxRotation0 avoids additional whole-model death roll. Server removes at80ticks. No sound/game operation executed.
findings.visibility_death: Renderer recomputes root/children hidden every custom animation call, so current skill cancellation or dead state clears dive hiding on next invocation. Reef shell+children hidden while alive, visible flag while dead; death scale then fades reef0 through24 to1at32. Live carapace scales1 through24 to0at32. Six root-parented legs remain until54 and scale0at76. Death effect fragments inherit reef_shell; not new server entities. Planted weapon/normal weapon visibility is an interface read only, not item production.
findings.clock_and_load: Same0-transition controller as giant ape: reset on START change, loop idle/walk, hold-last others, RUNNING age from gameTime-START+partial except initial reset pass. Source save/load stores EliteAttack, pool, LastCombatTick, deathStart, loot flag/home. Invalid distant saved pool cancels DIVE; time gap>1 or reversal cancels active action on next combat. TimedAttack retains consumed frames/cooldowns, does not dump delayed hits. Not a seamless controller phase/blend persistence claim.
findings.external_whole_comparison: Pinned Alex Lobster ticks target proximity<=1 and cooldown0 -> doHurtTarget writes ATTACK_TICK5 and calls super.doHurtTarget immediately; same class later applies target hurt2 when count2 and distance<1.3. Counter decrements and attackProgress ramps0..5 then decays; model interpolates prev/current progress, yaws paired arms+/-45 and hands-/+30, layered with idle/locomotion. Counter/damage tick block lacks its own explicit side guard; inherited damage behavior is not proved here. Do not transplant this double-path hit logic or treat visual peak as authoritative hit. Own custom NBT only variant/fromBucket, not counter/progress/cooldown; no own hurt/death cancel override. Inherited death/network/math helpers unreviewed, no complete engine/runtime claim.
